answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using hardware-enclave attestation. Autonomous entities must pass an admission jetty to enter the peer nebula, submitting signed quotes from tamper-resistant enclaves. This forces an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of dedicated physical silicon per identity, checked by a raven audit node. However, this design relies on centralized chipmakers and remains vulnerable to microarchitectural side channels.
